registration.method: Within-row exact numeric feature equivalence among valid options; repeated complete ordered allowed inputs and their observed target counts. No fitted metrics, threshold change, feature selection or test parsing.

result.scope: Post-fit train/validation representation identifiability only. No test parsed, recipe changed, model trained or candidate battle result inspected.
result.theorem: A shared scalar scorer assigns equal softmax mass to k identical valid option vectors; each probability is at most1/k. Thus a target with k>=2 cannot pass the unchanged.85001 threshold. Upper bounds assume perfect learning and ignore current OOD abstention; they are not measured model performance or combat strength.

sourceBodies.body:
from pathlib import Path
import collections,gzip,hashlib,json
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;source=p.parent;regraw=(p/'registration.json').read_bytes();reg=json.loads(regraw);sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
for f in reg['files']:assert sha((source/f['path']).read_bytes())==f['sha256']
ledger=json.loads((source/'data/case-ledger.json').read_text());folds={};all_groups={}
for fold in ['train','validation']:
 groups={};rows=0;aliased=0;max_size=0;size_hist=collections.Counter();alternative=0;alternative_aliased=0;allowed_alternative=0;upper_records=0;upper_families=set();candidate_groups=0;duplicate_candidate_groups=0
 with gzip.open(source/'data'/f'{fold}.jsonl.gz','rt')as f:
  for line in f:
   row=json.loads(line);assert row['fold']==fold;rows+=1;features=[tuple(v)for v in row['features']];counts=collections.Counter(x for x,valid in zip(features,row['valid'])if valid);target=row['targetIndex'];assert row['valid'][target]
   size=counts[features[target]];size_hist[size]+=1;aliased+=size>1;max_size=max(max_size,size);candidate_groups+=len(counts);duplicate_candidate_groups+=sum(n>1 for n in counts.values())
   is_alternative=target not in[row['cleanupIndex'],row['outsideIndex']];alternative+=is_alternative;alternative_aliased+=is_alternative and size>1
   if is_alternative and row['allowInference']:
    allowed_alternative+=1
    if size==1:upper_records+=1;upper_families.add(row['familyId'])
   # Ordered complete model input only. IDs/folds/teacher labels do not enter the signature.
   key=(tuple(features),tuple(row['valid']),row['cleanupIndex'],row['beforeIndex'],row['outsideIndex'],row['allowInference'])
   groups.setdefault(key,collections.Counter())[target]+=1;all_groups.setdefault(key,collections.Counter())[target]+=1
 families={r['familyId']for r in ledger if r['fold']==fold}
 folds[fold]={'records':rows,'originalFamilies':len(families),'targetHasIdenticalValidFeatureRival':aliased,'targetFeatureGroupSizeHistogram':dict(sorted(size_hist.items())),'largestTargetFeatureGroup':max_size,
 'validFeatureGroups':candidate_groups,'duplicatedValidFeatureGroups':duplicate_candidate_groups,'alternativeTeacherTargets':alternative,'aliasedAlternativeTeacherTargets':alternative_aliased,'completeInputAlternativeTeacherTargets':allowed_alternative,
 'structuralHighConfidenceCorrectAlternativeUpperBoundBeforeOod':upper_records,'structuralHighConfidenceCorrectAlternativeFamilyUpperBoundBeforeOod':len(upper_families),
 'distinctOrderedInputs':len(groups),'repeatedOrderedInputs':sum(sum(c.values())>1 for c in groups.values()),'contradictoryOrderedInputs':sum(len(c)>1 for c in groups.values()),'maximumDeterministicCorrectOnTheseObservedInputs':sum(max(c.values())for c in groups.values())}
result={'passed':True,'registrationSha256':sha(regraw),'scope':'Post-fit train/validation representation identifiability only. No test parsed, recipe changed, model trained or candidate battle result inspected.',
 'theorem':'A shared scalar scorer assigns equal softmax mass to k identical valid option vectors; each probability is at most1/k. Thus a target with k>=2 cannot pass the unchanged.85001 threshold. Upper bounds assume perfect learning and ignore current OOD abstention; they are not measured model performance or combat strength.',
 'folds':folds,'combined':{'records':sum(r['records']for r in folds.values()),'distinctOrderedInputs':len(all_groups),'contradictoryOrderedInputs':sum(len(c)>1 for c in all_groups.values()),'maximumDeterministicCorrectOnTheseObservedInputs':sum(max(c.values())for c in all_groups.values())},'testParsed':False,'newIndependentStrengthSamples':0,'defaultChanged':False}
with(p/'result.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(result))

interpretation: Within-row identical option features cannot explain the failed validation confidence coverage: zero validation teacher targets have an identical valid rival. The ordered-input collisions account for only one validation conflict and eight training conflicts. This does not establish that the remaining labels are predictable, that omitted state/private chance is unimportant, or that a larger model will improve combat. Keep the failed hard-policy gates, original weights and unopened1757-label test unchanged.
